raw_html: [[Proof Against Poison| Proof Against Poison +12]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Proof Against Poison| Proof Against Poison +12]]:''' This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +12 [[Enhancement bonus]] to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 13 + their Fortitude save).
